trip_one_star_average.referencePeriod: Trip.com weekday average; weekend (Friday-Saturday) average separately shown as US$55; result crawled 3 weeks ago (July 2026)
trip_one_star_average.sourceTitle: Best 1-Star Hotels in Hanoi (Prices & Deals) | Trip.com
trip_one_star_average.evidenceText: For 1 star hotels in Hanoi, the average price on weekdays is US$53, the average price on weekends (Friday–Saturday) is US$55.
trip_one_star_average.searchQuery: site:trip.com Hanoi Vietnam 1-star hotel average nightly price
trip_one_star_average.reason: The Trip.com result identifies Hanoi and the 1-star class and reports a numeric weekday nightly average in USD. No two-adult/one-room occupancy is stated, so the occupancy basis remains unknown; the separately reported weekend value is retained in evidence and was not averaged.

hotelscombined_one_star_average.reason: HotelsCombined results reported overall Hanoi averages and 3-, 4-, and 5-star trends, but no exact-city 1-star statistic. Overall and other-class values were rejected.
